text:
Maria Chen: Quick heads-up — prepping a micro patch for 1.6.2 to address the KV cache leak seen in prod. Goal: minimal diff, ship today if CI stays green.

Jon Patel: Which branch are we cutting from? Any freeze/cutoff window?

Maria Chen: Cut from release/1.6.x. Planning a fast-forward with a single cherry-pick (commit a1b2c3d). Requesting code-review and one approval. Cutoff: 2 hours from now unless blockers.

Tess Nguyen: I'll add the changelog snippet. Reminder to keep the description short: 'Fix: KV cache leak causing memory growth on sustained short-sequence loads.'

Arun Singh: I can take the cherry-pick + smoke run. Ping me when PR is up.

Maria Chen: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4521 — folks please review. CI: unit + integration. Deploy steps in PR description.

deploy-bot: CI started for PR #4521 · units: 118 · integration: queued

Jon Patel: Noted a flaky test in integration suite last run. @Arun can you rerun if it flakes? Might be unrelated, but we need a clean green before bumping.

Arun Singh: Will watch. If it flakes, I'll isolate by running `pytest tests/integration/test_kv_cache.py::test_cache_eviction -k slow` locally and report.

Maria Chen: Changelog snippet (to paste into PR):
```
### 1.6.2 (patch)
- Fix: KV cache leak causing memory growth on sustained short-sequence loads. (a1b2c3d)
```

Tess Nguyen: LGTM on changelog. I'll post release note after merge.

Jon Patel: If CI is green, can we keep the deploy window to low-traffic hours? Suggesting +1h after merge to allow canary monitoring.

Maria Chen: Agreed. Deploy plan: merge -> canary to 10% for 30m -> full rollout. If any regression, rollback via `git revert` + hotfix branch (see runbook).

Arun Singh: I've queued a smoke run now. If green, I'll merge and tag.

deploy-bot: CI passed for PR #4521 · units: 118 · integration: 45m · status: success

Maria Chen: Merged and tagged v1.6.2. Starting canary at 10% now. Thanks all :tada:

Tess Nguyen: Posting brief changelog and release note in #announcements after canary looks good.

Jon Patel: Monitoring dashboards look stable so far. I'll keep an eye for KV mem growth for the next 1h.

Arun Singh: Everything holding steady. No regressions in canary.

Maria Chen: Closing loop — release completed, minimal diff achieved. Follow-up: add a unit test to cover cache boundary next sprint. Thanks team.
